diagnostics.purpose: Compare scaling 1 and 2 of the same fitted CCA.

diagnostics.purpose: Audit NOCA modern fire assignment against Wilson reference plots.
diagnostics.interpretation: The 303 shared plots agree. The cleaned 305-plot universe excludes CARI449/CARI450 for GPS problems; the Wilson reference is not substituted for it.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare fire-event detection in all four lake records.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each panel shows the charcoal residual, the local noise threshold (dashed), accepted events (filled circles), and peaks rejected by the minimum-count screen (red crosses). The three MORA records use 95% thresholds; Panther Potholes uses 99%. These events are used later to identify high-fire periods.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare official CharAnalysis results with published Walsh totals.
diagnostics.interpretation: The official CharAnalysis implementation and Walsh publication give different event totals. This comparison is separate from the primary tapas event catalog, whose thresholds were not tuned to force agreement.

diagnostics.purpose: Expose signed changes, phase support, and era construction.
diagnostics.interpretation: Any qualifying variable creates a climate-change cell. Only adjacent cells merge; the unsigned composite is context.

diagnostics.purpose: Work through centered event frequencies at 2,300 cal BP.
diagnostics.interpretation: Within-core normalization and site-specific robust thresholds yield MORA high fire and NOCA no high fire for the worked date.

diagnostics.purpose: Inspect macrofossil sampling and accepted fire detections on native 100-year climate cells before CCA.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each prepared macrofossil ID is counted once at its median age across the 100 cached Bacon draws. Separate lake lines share the same MORA/NOCA sample-count scale. Fire lines sum accepted detections from fully covered cores: at least two MORA regional cores, or Panther Potholes for NOCA. Grey cells lack adequate charcoal coverage; covered zero-event cells remain zero and lines do not bridge gaps. MORA totals may use two or three covered cores and do not deduplicate regional fires. Fire counts are source detections, not normalized fire_activity or CHAR, and differing source resolution prevents interpreting raw park counts as comparable fire intensity. Median-age placement does not propagate dating uncertainty; these cells are descriptive counts, not independent 100-year vegetation responses.

diagnostics.purpose: Work through WA/LC movement, lag, ratio, and angle.

diagnostics.purpose: Primary correction-effect era contrasts
diagnostics.interpretation: Selected primary GLS Anthropocene-minus-Holocene contrasts for pace- and direction correction effects, with conditional 95% Satterthwaite intervals in CCA distance per century. MORA/NOCA are blue/orange; correction labels retain their colors. Stars mark unadjusted p < 0.05; nonsignificant dots, bars and annotations are faint. Signed fitted-mean ratios are descriptive and can be unstable near zero. Bacon model sensitivity is currently on hold.

diagnostics.purpose: Appendix: extended Anthropocene predictor coefficients
diagnostics.interpretation: Site + elevation + climate-change rate + burned, with independent residuals and park-specific residual variances. Intercepts are omitted. Elevation is displayed per 100 m; model fitting uses the original untransformed covariates. Conditional 95% intervals and descriptive R² are shown for observed lag change, pace correction effect and direction correction effect.

diagnostics.purpose: Species contribution rates by era and park.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each primary lake transition and each modern plot pair contributes once per component. Boxes describe variation among actual transitions, not among offsets or Bacon draws. Species contributions are rates; climate contributions remain displacements. Undefined reference directions are omitted, with counts retained.

diagnostics.purpose: Seasonal climate displacement contributions by era and park.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each primary lake transition and each modern plot pair contributes once per component. Boxes describe variation among actual transitions, not among offsets or Bacon draws. diagnostics.purpose: Within-park species contribution means and GLS coefficients, including intercepts, by era.
diagnostics.interpretation: Separate Holocene and Anthropocene pages retain all 14 species. Blue MORA and orange NOCA diamonds show arithmetic means of finite primary contributions from the boxplot data, each transition/plot weighted equally; these descriptive means have no model intervals. Circles and capped bars show within-park GLS coefficients and conditional 95% intervals; estimates with unadjusted p ≥ 0.05 are faded. NE denotes an unavailable model in that park, with explanations in captions. Holocene intercepts are predictions at zero climate/fire predictors. Anthropocene MORA is intercept-only (overall park mean); NOCA retains burned versus unburned, with unburned as its intercept. No MORA fire coefficient is fitted. Columns have separate x-axis scales.

diagnostics.purpose: Primary species-model normalized residual diagnostics.
diagnostics.interpretation: Four pages separate Holocene MORA, Holocene NOCA, Anthropocene MORA and Anthropocene NOCA. Residuals are from each species model within that park; Bacon model sensitivity is currently on hold.

diagnostics.purpose: Paired pace/direction model normalized-residual diagnostics
diagnostics.interpretation: Joint era × park × correction GLS on transitions with both corrections defined. Temporal MA(1) and paired correction correlation are modeled together; normalized residuals account for the full fitted covariance.
